scientific.integrity: The result follows directly from the paper-form log-gradient direction and practical convex-combination re-normalization. Independent positive task rescaling cancels inside each log gradient but transforms the re-normalization scalar by an exact weighted harmonic mean.
limitations: Independent-rescaling law is pointwise at a matched parameter/logit state.
Exact full-trajectory equivalence with a fixed reciprocal learning-rate adjustment is claimed only for common task scaling.
A fixed additive numerical floor can introduce additional scale dependence if it is not rescaled with the positive task objective.
No empirical or convergence-rate claim is made.

title: FAMO re-normalization has an exact harmonic-mean loss-scale law
